args.title: Warehouse Automation 2026 — Combined Summary (Saltmarsh blog + companion)
args.body:
- Pick rates rose 18% in 2026 with the adoption of autonomous carts.
- Integration took twice as long as planned, tempering the overall gains.
- The single biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.

Source: https://blog.saltmarsh.example/2026/warehouse and its companion piece at https://insights.saltmarsh.example/warehouse/companion
